specs.description: `types.ts` — Types. Within that limit it records no call to this module. `Common` carries `label`, `id`, `size` and `className`. `FieldSize` is `(typeof FIELD_SIZES)[number]` and `FieldProps` is `AsInput | AsTextarea`.
